summary: The visual render features consistent semi-realistic 3D environments and stylized character models. Visual representation frequently mismatches spoken content, with missing key object details like stickers and broken gourds.

clean: Outdoor environment perspective and table placements remain consistent across basic scenes.
Character body proportions and placement fit the stylized art direction.
unclean: shot 7: Bombilla appears isolated without a mate gourd on the table.
shot 8: Straw stands upright on the table surface without support.
shot 10: Dented thermos is represented by basic smooth blue cylinders.

clean: 3D lighting and shadow distribution match the outdoor environment.
Text rendering remains sharp and legible against backgrounds.
unclean: shot 2: Interface graphic covers the character face completely.
shot 11: Thermos asset lacks the decals described in the spoken text.

issues.fix: Place bombilla inside a mate gourd prop.
Reposition UI banner higher or adjust camera angle.

issues.problem: Bombilla stands vertically on table surface unsupported.
issues.fix: Rest bombilla horizontally or insert into gourd.

issues.problem: Thermos model lacks dented detail mentioned in narration.
issues.fix: Use a deformed mesh asset with visible dents.
Add sticker texture overlays to thermos model.

learnings.rule: Avoid using generic placeholder geometry when specific object flaws are narrated.
Keep upper screen region clear of overlapping character faces during UI overlays.
